tokens.note: Two coexisting systems: a Framer-built marketing homepage (orange #ff8d08 CTA, full-pill geometry, Noto Sans CJK KR headings + Inter latin, playful category accents) and a GitBook-style developer docs portal (neutral #1d1d1d ink on Noto Sans, #d8d9d9 hairlines, 6-12px radius). Primary = the orange marketing CTA.
